💡 Suggested actions to cut RTO & returns

Generated from patterns in this batch — use judgement, these are pointers not rules.

    Fraud & duplicate-risk orders

    Exchange orders — no extra profit

    Why flag these

    An exchange replaces the item at no additional charge — you re-ship a product for the same original order value, so there's no incremental profit and you absorb the extra shipping/packing cost. Cancelling ones you can't fulfil profitably is often the better call.

    Exact panel path to cancel/reject an exchange

    1. If the exchange hasn't been accepted/packed yet: Supplier Panel → Orders → Confirm & Pack tab → find the sub-order number → click "Reject Item" → pick a reason from the dropdown (e.g. "Not fulfillable") → click "Confirm Cancellation".
    2. If it already shows as a return/exchange request: go to the Returns tab → open the matching sub-order → you'll see Approve / Reject — choose Reject and enter the reason (this gets shown to the customer automatically).
    3. If neither option is available for that order's current status: go to Support (left sidebar) → Help tab → category "Returns/RTO & Exchange" → select the closest matching issue (e.g. "I want to cancel/reject a return or exchange") → submit with the sub-order number in the description. Track it under the "My Tickets" tab.
    4. Use this selectively — frequent cancellations can affect your seller rating, so reject only exchanges that would genuinely run at a loss.

    These tab names are current as of Meesho's own seller Learning Hub, but panels get updated — if wording doesn't match exactly, use the Help tab's search to find the closest option.

    Size suggestions by state

    Based only on your own saved returns experience
    There's no verified public dataset mapping Indian states to exact shoe/clothing size differences — the CSIR-CLRI national foot survey confirmed regional variation exists, but the size-conversion numbers aren't public yet. So instead of guessing, this tool lets you save the size adjustment you've learned from your own return patterns per state, and it will remember it (in your browser) and apply it to every scan from now on.

    🧭 What this tool does

    You upload a Meesho sub-order label / invoice PDF (any number of orders in one file). It reads every order off the page and cross-checks the whole batch for patterns that correlate with fake orders, prank orders, or return/RTO-prone behaviour — all using only what's printed in this file, since it has no access to your Meesho account's real delivery history.

    🚩 How an order gets flagged "Likely fake" or "Watchlist"

    Each order is checked against these signals. More matching signals = higher risk:

    • Same address, different name — the strongest signal. Often means one person ordering repeatedly under fake identities.
    • Same name, different addresses — could mean a shared/fake identity being reused across orders.
    • Same customer + address repeated — duplicate order pattern.
    • PIN-code concentration — one PIN accounting for an unusually large share of orders in a large batch.
    • Quantity or value outliers — statistically unusual amounts versus the rest of the batch.

    An order needs multiple independent signals (or one very strong one) to reach "Likely fake" — a single common name or a short address is never enough on its own.

    🎨 Colour legend

    Likely fake — strong, multiple duplicate/identity signals
    Watchlist — one moderate signal, worth a quick look
    Exchange — no added profit, consider the cancellation steps
    Normal — no notable pattern found

    📑 Using the tabs

    • Overview — headline counts, optional charts, and auto-generated suggestions.
    • Fraud Orders — every flagged order, ranked by priority, with the exact reasons and a recommended next step.
    • Exchange Orders — all exchange-type orders plus the exact panel steps to cancel one.
    • State Insights — which states order the most, which size each state prefers, and your own saved state size-adjustment rules.
    • All Orders — the complete parsed table, for audit or export to CSV.

    ⚠️ Limits, honestly

    This tool cannot see your Meesho account's actual delivery, RTO, or return history — it only sees what's printed on this PDF. A flag here means "worth a manual check before shipping," not a confirmed fraud. Use it to prioritise which orders deserve a phone call or manual hold, not as an automatic reject list.
